jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Software Engineering Intern

**Job Details:**

* **Job Type:** Internship
* **Duration:** 6 Months
* **Work Setting:** In\-person \- New Delhi

**About the Role:** Are you passionate about writing clean code, building scalable backend systems, and automating manual workflows? We are a growing Healthcare Tech startup currently in an exciting phase of setting up our core operations.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and driven Software Engineering Intern to join our IT team. In this role, you won't just be fetching coffee—you will get hands\-on experience writing Python scripts, managing code repositories, building APIs, and working with cloud technologies. If you want to build systems from the ground up and make a real impact, we want to hear from you!

**What You Will Do:**

* Write clean, efficient **Python scripts** to solve backend challenges, process data, and automate daily tasks.
* Actively use **Git and GitHub** to manage code, create branches, submit pull requests, and collaborate seamlessly with the team.
* Develop, test, and maintain **APIs** to ensure smooth communication between different software components.
* Write and execute **Bash scripts** to streamline server operations and technical workflows.
* Assist in setting up and managing internal workflows using Google Workspace and automation tools.

**Requirements \& Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Final\-year student or recent graduate with a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **Python Programming:** Strong foundational knowledge of Python (logic, scripting, and basic data manipulation).
* **Version Control:** Solid hands\-on experience with **Git and GitHub** (you should be comfortable with commits, branching, and pull requests).
* **API Fundamentals:** Good understanding of how web APIs work, including how to test and integrate them.
* **Command Line:** Comfortable navigating the terminal and writing basic **Bash scripts**.
* *Please include a link to your GitHub profile or portfolio in your resume/application!*

**Bonus Points (Nice\-to\-Haves):** *Don't worry if you don't know all of these—we are happy to mentor and teach you! However, any prior exposure to the following will give you a major edge:*

* Previous internship or academic projects demonstrating solid backend development.
* Exposure to cloud platforms and containerization (e.g., **AWS, Docker**).
* Basic understanding of **CI/CD** pipelines.
* Experience with no\-code/low\-code workflow automation tools like **n8n** or **Zapier**.
* A genuine interest in improving the Healthcare Technology sector.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Mentorship:** Get direct guidance and real\-world training on advanced, industry\-standard tools like AWS, Docker, and n8n.
* **Real Impact:** Work closely with our core team to build foundational tech operations that will directly support our growth.
* **Career Growth:** A 6\-month immersive experience that acts as the perfect stepping stone from a student to a full\-time software engineer.

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Paschim Vihar, Delhi, Delhi: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
jobs.description:
**Position:** Full Stack Developer Intern  
**Employment Type:** Internship  
**Duration:** 3–6 Months  
**Location:** On\-site  
**Stipend:** 8\-15k

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Full Stack Developer Intern** who is interested in building modern, scalable, and user\-friendly web applications. The intern will work across both frontend and backend development and gain hands\-on experience in designing, developing, testing, and deploying web applications.

The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in web development and a willingness to learn new technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop responsive and user\-friendly web applications.
* Build frontend interfaces using modern web technologies.
* Develop backend services, APIs, and application logic.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs.
* Work with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
* Implement authentication, authorization, and basic security practices.
* Debug and resolve frontend and backend issues.
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code.
* Test applications and fix bugs.
* Use Git/GitHub for version control.
* Collaborate with designers, developers, and other team members.
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
* Assist with application deployment and maintenance.

**Required Skills Frontend**

* Good knowledge of **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**.
* Familiarity with **React.js** or another modern frontend framework.
* Understanding of responsive web design.
* Basic knowledge of UI/UX principles.

Backend

* Knowledge of at least one backend technology such as **Node.js/Express, Python/Django, Python/FastAPI, Java/Spring Boot**, etc.
* Understanding of REST APIs.
* Basic understanding of authentication and authorization.

Database

* Knowledge of **SQL** and relational databases such as MySQL/PostgreSQL.
* Familiarity with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases is a plus.

Other

* Familiarity with Git/GitHub.
* Good understanding of programming fundamentals.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.

Good to Have

* TypeScript experience.
* Next.js experience.
* Docker knowledge.
* Cloud deployment experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with CI/CD.
* Knowledge of testing frameworks.
* Experience building and deploying personal or academic projects.

Eligibility

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong interest in web and software development.
* Freshers and students with relevant projects are encouraged to apply.
* GitHub/project portfolio is a plus.

What You Will Gain

* Hands\-on experience in frontend and backend development.
* Experience building complete web applications.
* Exposure to real\-world development practices.
* Experience with APIs, databases, Git, and deployment.
* Mentorship from experienced developers.
* Opportunity to work on production\-oriented projects.
* Certificate and potential full\-time opportunity based on performance.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

* Experience with authentication (JWT, OAuth2\).
* Knowledge of Django REST Framework (DRF).
* Interest in AI/ML integration in web applications.

**Education:**

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.

**Perks:**

* Hands\-on work with **cutting\-edge AI healthcare technology**.
* Flexible and collaborative startup culture.
* Mentorship from experienced engineers.
* Opportunity to work on real\-world telemedicine applications.

**How to Apply:**  
Send your resume, portfolio/GitHub, and a brief introduction to **\[careers@aevevotechnology.com]** with the subject line: **“Full Stack Developer Intern – React/Django”**.

Job Type: Internship

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Sholinganallur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

* How do you rate yourself in Tailwind (0\-10\)?
* Have did a python full stack development course in intitute?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* React: 1 year (Preferred)
* Django: 1 year (Preferred)
* Tailwind: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Web Developer Intern
jobs.description:
We're Hiring \| Web Developer Intern (AI\-Powered Web Development)

Location: Hyderabad (On\-site)

Type: Full\-time Internship \| 0\-6 Months Experience \| Immediate Joiners Preferred

About The Smarketers

The Smarketers is an award\-winning B2B growth marketing agency helping technology, SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and enterprise businesses accelerate growth through branding, web development, demand generation, marketing automation, and AI\-driven digital experiences.

Our web development team builds modern, high\-performance websites focused on user experience, SEO, accessibility, speed, scalability, and conversions. We actively leverage AI\-powered development workflows using tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and similar technologies to improve development quality, accelerate delivery, and automate repetitive tasks.

We're looking for someone who's passionate about modern web development, eager to learn, and excited about using AI to build better websites faster.

Application Note: Please include links to websites, GitHub repositories, Figma\-to\-website projects, WordPress/Webflow/HubSpot CMS projects, internships, or personal work you've built or contributed to. A strong portfolio is valued more than years of experience.

Role Overview

As a Web Developer Intern, you'll work closely with our design, marketing, content, and development teams to build responsive, high\-performing websites for global B2B brands.

You'll assist in developing websites using WordPress, HubSpot CMS, or Webflow while learning industry best practices for performance, accessibility, SEO, and user experience.

We believe AI is transforming the way websites are built. You'll be expected to use AI tools throughout the development lifecycle—from converting Figma designs into responsive websites and HTML into reusable CMS templates to debugging, optimizing code, generating components, improving performance, and accelerating repetitive development tasks while maintaining high\-quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

Website Development

Build responsive websites using WordPress, HubSpot CMS, or Webflow.

Convert Figma designs into pixel\-perfect, responsive web pages.

Convert HTML/CSS layouts into reusable CMS templates and components.

Customize themes, templates, and reusable website sections.

Develop websites that are responsive, accessible, and optimized across devices and browsers.

Assist in website launches, updates, maintenance, and ongoing improvements.

AI\-Assisted Development

Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, or similar AI coding assistants to improve development efficiency and quality.

Leverage AI for code generation, debugging, refactoring, documentation, testing, and repetitive development tasks.

Validate AI\-generated code and ensure it meets production\-quality standards.

Continuously explore new AI workflows and tools to improve productivity and development quality.

Performance \& Quality

Optimize websites for speed, Core Web Vitals, SEO, accessibility, and overall user experience.

Test websites across multiple browsers, screen sizes, and devices.

Identify and resolve UI, responsiveness, and functionality issues.

Follow modern web development best practices and coding standards.

Collaboration

Collaborate with designers, marketers, content writers, and developers throughout project execution.

Translate business and design requirements into functional web experiences.

Assist with hosting configurations, staging environments, deployments, and routine maintenance.

Participate in team discussions, code reviews, and continuous learning initiatives.

Skills We're Looking For

0\-6 months of experience through internships, academic projects, freelance work, or personal projects.

Hands\-on experience with at least one of the following platforms:

WordPress

HubSpot CMS

Webflow

Exposure to or a basic understanding of one or more of the remaining platforms is highly preferred.

Good understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, responsive web development, and modern web standards.

Familiarity with Figma and the ability to convert designs into responsive websites.

Exposure to AI development tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, or similar AI coding assistants.

Willingness to adopt AI\-assisted development workflows to improve productivity and code quality.

Basic understanding of Git/version control is an advantage.

Exposure to Elementor, PHP, or modern frontend frameworks is a plus.

Interest in website performance optimization, technical SEO, accessibility (WCAG), and Core Web Vitals.

Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, eagerness to learn, and a collaborative mindset.

What You'll Learn

Enterprise website development for global B2B brands.

AI\-assisted web development workflows.

Figma\-to\-WordPress, HubSpot CMS, and Webflow implementation.

HTML\-to\-CMS conversion techniques.

Website performance optimization and Core Web Vitals.

Technical SEO and accessibility best practices.

Modern CMS development workflows.

Version control using Git and collaborative development practices.

Working with cross\-functional teams on real client projects.

Why Join The Smarketers?

Work on real\-world projects for global technology and enterprise clients.

Learn directly from experienced web developers, marketers, and strategists.

Gain hands\-on experience with modern AI\-powered development workflows.

Build expertise across multiple CMS platforms, performance optimization, SEO, and web technologies.

Grow in a collaborative, innovation\-driven environment that encourages continuous learning and experimentation.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* How many months/years of experience do you have in Web Development
* Do you have hands\-on experience with WordPress?
* Do you know either HubSpot CMS or Webflow?
* Have

jobs.description:
Full Stack Developer Internship

**Company:** GTEC Computer Education  
**Job Title:** Full Stack Developer Intern  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full\-time Internship  
**Internship Type:** Paid Internship  
**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year  
**Duration:** 3–6 Months

About the Internship

GTEC Computer Education is looking for enthusiastic and motivated **Full Stack Developer Interns** to join our development team. This is a **paid internship** designed for freshers and aspiring developers who want to gain practical experience working on real\-world web development projects.

You will work with our development team to build, improve, and maintain responsive web applications while gaining hands\-on experience with modern frontend and backend technologies.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop responsive and user\-friendly web pages and applications.
* Build frontend interfaces using **HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap**.
* Develop backend functionality using **Python and Django**.
* Create and integrate **REST APIs**.
* Work with databases such as **MySQL**.
* Perform CRUD operations and database integration.
* Debug and fix application issues.
* Test applications for functionality, responsiveness, and performance.
* Use **Git and GitHub** for version control.
* Participate in real\-world development projects.
* Collaborate with trainers and development team members.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of **HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript**.
* Basic understanding of **Python programming**.
* Knowledge of **Django / Django REST Framework** is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of **MySQL or other databases**.
* Understanding of responsive web design.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub is preferred.
* Good problem\-solving and logical\-thinking skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies.

Who Can Apply?

* BCA / B.Sc Computer Science / B.E / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc Computer Science students or graduates.
* Freshers who want to start a career in Full Stack Development.
* Candidates with basic programming knowledge.
* Candidates looking for practical, industry\-oriented experience.
* Students who have completed a Python or Web Development course.

What We Offer

* **Paid Internship**
* Hands\-on experience with real\-world projects.
* Practical Full Stack Development training.
* Mentorship from experienced developers/trainers.
* Experience in frontend and backend development.
* Git \& GitHub workflow exposure.
* REST API development experience.
* Database integration experience.
* Internship Certificate upon successful completion.
* Career guidance and placement support.
* Opportunity to improve your professional development skills.

Technologies You May Work With

**Frontend:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap  
**Backend:** Python, Django, Django REST Framework  
**Database:** MySQL  
**Tools:** Git, GitHub, VS Code  
**APIs:** REST API

Why Join GTEC Computer Education?

This internship is suitable for candidates who want to move beyond classroom learning and gain **practical Full Stack Development experience**. You will have the opportunity to work on real projects, strengthen your coding skills, and build a stronger portfolio for your career.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with their updated resume.

**Job Type:** Full\-time Internship  
**Internship:** Paid  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** 0–1 Year / Freshers  
**Duration:** 3–6 Months

Pay: From ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
